items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Clarence Muse put it in the Clarence Muse biography about him being a lawyer... So he put the lawyer down.

ctx.x: I was one of the boys that the parents wanted to be what he wanted to be. All except one thing, I didn't want to be a doctor. My father wanted me to be a doctor. But I didn't want to be a doctor because I couldn't stand the idea of people dying. To me I couldn't see that as I see it today, as I see what that doctor situation is today, too. If I had been a doctor I'd have taken care of everything. Same as I dance, I'd take everything and dance, I'd take everything in a situation, don't care what it was. I'm sorry…

Clarence Muse put it in the Clarence Muse biography about him being a lawyer, studied to be a lawyer. But the field was so small for the Negros as lawyers that he thought he'd be an entertainer. So he put the lawyer down.
